 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Arun Kumar Jha
 Oral Order
Present learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 as well as learned A.P.P. for the State.

02. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the present case has been filed by the opposite party no.2/ complainant who is the wife of the petitioner under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel further submits that both the parties are ready to explore the possibility of settlement, for which they submit that the matter may be referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
03. Having considered the aforesaid submission, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57352 of 2024(2) dt.11-09-2024 matter is referred to the Patna High Court Mediation and Conciliation Centre.
